clips.title: The story
paras: Bolgan's Hole is a subterranean cavern nestled in the southern cliffs of Gelkis Village in Desolace. It serves as the inner sanctum of the Gelkis centaur clan, housing their highest chieftains and sacred earth relics.

Carved deep into the craggy bluffs overlooking the Gelkis encampment, Bolgan's Hole functions as the command center for the tribe. It is here that the ruling khan holds court, surrounded by veteran guards and the tribe's most influential shamans. The cavern offers natural fortification against rival clans, most notably the bloodthirsty Magram centaur to the east.

Beyond its military importance, the cave possesses profound religious significance to the Gelkis. Luminous blue mineral formations known as the tears of Theradras sprout from the damp stone walls. Gelkis shamans obsessively harvest and guard these crystals, revering them as divine blessings that confer the subterranean protection of Princess Theradras, the primal earth elemental mother of the centaur race.
